Sampson Lynchbg  Wash'n Sept 30th
Grapes Lamp Katy To Shelby Curtis Zebra
Send Pilgrim Alberger his Supt & the
Orderly who procured the wax for Shelter
Briscoe to Growl by to knights train
yoke Tea T. Eckert act asst Brutus


No 1  12 M
Sampson Lynchbg Va  Wash Octo. 1 1865
Frances for Mrs M H Alberger plug publish
ghost Church St dryden unity <unclear>Gvt</unclear>from Hall
the Safe Key and bring it with you
Hall can leave the safe open by taking
the money papers home with him Every night
Sig M H Alberger pilgrim & a vinton
